title: Semi-definite programs for online control of nonlinear systems with stability guarantees
summary: This paper develops a semidefinite-programming-based method for online feedback control of nonlinear systems using a state-dependent representation. We formulate sequences of time-varying SDPs whose optimal solutions jointly yield a stabilizing feedback controller and a Lyapunov certificate satisfying stability conditions and quadratic performance specifications. We further establish compact conditions certifying recursive feasibility of the resulting SDP sequences and derive estimates of the region of attraction.
